**Coaching Note:**

Your queen on c4 was perfectly placed to spot the fork. When White's knight is pinned to its king and close to your queen, always check if you can capture it with check—especially when it opens lines for your rook. Here, **Qxc3+** wins immediately: if White recaptures with the b-pawn, Rb1 is checkmate; if Rc2 blocks, Qxc2 is checkmate. Look for forcing sequences where checks narrow your opponent's options to one losing choice.
